name: Omachill
author: Ronny Iversen
description: Float every window on the current workspace in place, with glass and soft corners; press again to tile them back exactly where they were.

barWidget.description: Shows when the active workspace is chilled; click to toggle, right-click for the panel and settings.

schema.label: Toggle key
schema.description: Hyprland bind string for toggling chill mode on the current workspace (empty = no key). Omarchy's Calendar webapp sits on the default; it is unbound while this plugin is enabled.

schema.label: Shrink (%)
schema.description: How much a window shrinks when chilled: every side moves in by this share of the window's own size, so 10 keeps 80 % of its width and height, centred where it was.

schema.label: Newcomer size (%)
schema.description: Size of a window that floats in on a chilled workspace with nothing to copy from, as a share of the work area.

schema.label: Corner radius
schema.description: Corner radius of chilled windows, in pixels.

schema.label: Edge margin (px)
schema.description: How close to the screen edges a newcomer may flock.

schema.label: Flock gap (px)
schema.description: Breathing room a newcomer keeps from the windows already there when it picks its spot.

schema.label: New windows join
schema.description: A window opened on a chilled workspace floats in at the size of the others instead of tiling full-size behind them.

schema.label: Moving converts
schema.description: A window moved onto a chilled workspace joins the floaters; a chilled window moved to a tiling workspace tiles.

schema.label: Chill small workspaces
schema.description: A workspace chills itself while it holds no more than the limit below, and tiles back the moment the next window arrives. The toggle key still works; auto takes the workspace back the next time its window count changes.

schema.label: Chill up to (windows)
schema.description: How many windows a workspace may hold and still chill itself. Windows that were floating on their own are not counted; hidden ones are somewhere else.

schema.label: Hide and restore keys
schema.description: Bind the two keys below. Off keeps hidden windows restorable from the panel and from scripting.

schema.label: Hide key
schema.description: Parks the focused window on its monitor's hidden pile, keeping its size and place (empty = no key). macOS Cmd+H.

schema.label: Restore key
schema.description: Brings the most recently hidden window back onto the workspace you are looking at, tiled or floated exactly where it was (empty = no key).

schema.label: Notify on toggle
schema.description: Desktop notification when a workspace is chilled or tiled back.

schema.label: Hide widget when nothing is chilled
schema.description: Show the sofa only while the workspace on that monitor is chilled.
